label: BTC address (bech32)
note: Well-known P2WPKH example from BIP-173 / Bitcoin Wiki.

label: Cosmos ATOM address (20-chain HRP swap)
note: Deterministic test address (hash160 = bytes 0..19) used by the ckc test suite. Watch the 19 cross-chain alternates — same key, every chain in the family.

label: Corrupted BTC address (whitespace repair)
note: Bitcoin Genesis Block address with leading/trailing whitespace. Enable 'Show repair trace' to see strip-ws fire.

label: BIP-39 mnemonic (12 words, test vector 1)
value: abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon about
note: Standard BIP-39 spec test vector. Masked by default — unmasking requires confirmation.

label: Monero address (base58 block-encoded)
note: Synthetic mainnet address (network byte 0x12 + 32-byte spend + 32-byte view pubkey). Monero uses BLOCK-ENCODED base58 (8-byte blocks → 11 chars), not whole-payload — 95 chars total.

label: Cardano address (Shelley bech32)
note: Synthetic Shelley-era mainnet address (addr1 HRP). Cardano also has a Byron-era base58 format (DdzFFz...) — bech32 is the current standard.

label: Polkadot address (SS58 format)
note: Synthetic mainnet SS58 address (prefix 0 + 32-byte ed25519 pubkey). SS58 uses a variable-length Blake2b-512 checksum over the 'SS58PRE' domain separator.

label: Stellar public key (base32 + CRC16-XMODEM)
note: Synthetic G... account key (version byte 0x30 + 32-byte ed25519 pubkey). Triggers the CRC16-XMODEM checksum validator — 56 chars, base32 RFC4648 unpadded.

label: BIP-340 x-only pubkey (secp256k1)
note: Official BIP-340 schnorr test vector #0 (secret key = 3). 32-byte x-only secp256k1 pubkey, 64 hex chars. Source: github.com/bitcoin/bips/blob/master/bip-0340/test-vectors.csv. Spec test vector — never on mainnet.

label: ETH contract address (EIP-55 checksum)
note: Uniswap V2 Router02 contract address on mainnet Ethereum. Public on-chain contract (not a private key). EIP-55 checksum is valid — mixed-case hex encoding. Source: Uniswap docs + Etherscan verified contract.
